name: Project Babble
summary: Project Babble / Baballonia 摄像头面捕，直接读 OSC，不需要 VRCFT。
description: 接收 Baballonia 的 OSC over UDP 输出（默认 127.0.0.1:8888），支持单消息与 #bundle 分包。45 条面部地址映射到 Unified Expressions；眼通道是 Baballonia 独有的 PascalCase /LeftEyeX、/LeftEyeY、/LeftEyeLid 等 6 条。归档的 VRCFT-Babble 并不发送这些眼地址，因此本模块以活跃上游 Baballonia 为准，风险已在仓库 README 说明。头姿与瞳孔不提供。
usage: 1. 在 Baballonia 里启用 VRCFT / OSC 输出，目标填本机地址与端口 8888。2. 关闭 VRCFaceTracking 避免抢端口。3. 在「模块」页设为启动并重启引擎。4. 未验证：眼动地址的极化仅由代码推断，gaze 置信度压到 0.5，请真机确认。

en.summary: Project Babble / Baballonia webcam tracking over OSC — no VRCFT needed.
en.description: Reads Baballonia's OSC-over-UDP output (127.0.0.1:8888 by default) including #bundle splitting. 45 face addresses map onto Unified Expressions; the eye channel uses Baballonia's own PascalCase addresses (/LeftEyeX, /LeftEyeY, /LeftEyeLid, ...). The archived VRCFT-Babble module never sent those eye addresses, so this follows the active upstream and the risk is documented in the repo README. No head pose, no pupil.
en.usage: 1. Enable VRCFT / OSC output in Baballonia, pointed at this PC on port 8888. 2. Quit VRCFaceTracking (same port). 3. Enable the module and restart the engine. 4. Untested: eye address polarity is inferred from code only, confidence capped at 0.5 — please confirm on hardware.
